name: Microsoft Agent Framework Runtime
mechanism: Combines agents, sessions, graph workflows, checkpoint storage, approval-required tools and optional self-hosted or durable Microsoft infrastructure integrations.
use_when: Python or .NET teams need explicit workflows and Microsoft ecosystem integrations
Checkpointed workflows, approval and hosting helpers match the application boundary
avoid_when: Required language or hosting surfaces remain preview and cannot be isolated
Bulk-synchronous superstep barriers conflict with latency or independent branch requirements
expected_effects: Shared agent and workflow model across Python and .NET surfaces
Optional durable checkpoint and Azure hosting integration
failure_modes: Preview package changes break state or hosting contracts
Checkpoint objects or storage reads alias mutable state instead of preserving snapshots
Concurrent branches create unreachable sibling lineage
Pending request types fail restricted serialization or resume
Superstep barriers serialize progress behind slow parallel branches
Application assumes hosting helpers provide authentication or tenant authorization
required_evals: release-pinned immutable checkpoint snapshot after restore
storage-read isolation including nested mutable state
concurrent sibling lineage and latest-lineage reachability
upgrade downgrade resume and rollback rehearsal
crash injection around authoritative effects with duplicate omitted and unauthorized-effect counters
